decisions.reason: As a core extension of the firm's authentication and secure communication platform in a growing security market, management would keep it unless several years of results had fallen below aspiration, though the lack of recent website visibility slightly raises withdrawal risk.

Because mobile signing fits the firm's strategic move toward secure app-based interactions and digital contracts, boundedly rational management would usually continue it absent clear underperformance, while allowing some risk that it is folded into a broader offer.

The compliance-focused security suite matches the firm's capabilities and enterprise customer base well, so it is likely to be retained unless its niche demand persistently misses aspiration levels, with some added uncertainty from its limited later visibility.
